title: Comprador Pleno | Conhecimento em Reforma Tributária
description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer fazer parte da nossa turma?

São mais 30 anos recheados de aprendizados e doces conquistas. A Cultura vivenciada na empresa traduz a essência de quem somos e onde queremos chegar.

Vivemos para Juntos tocar a vida das pessoas compartilhando momentos especiais.

Ingredientes como Foco, Atitude, União, Alegria e muita Paixão por realizar nos impulsiona a fazer sempre o melhor, transformando o Ordinário em Extraordinário.

A nossa turma é formada por pessoas que fazem da Cacau show um lugar especial para se trabalhar, onde todos são tratados com igualdade, independentemente de gênero, raça, idade, origem ou orientação sexual, sendo nosso processo baseado em meritocracia.

Na Cacau todos são Show!!!

Se você é apaixonado pelo que faz, possui senso de dono e muito “gás” para trabalhar, essa vaga é a sua cara!!!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Mapeamento de impacto tributário na base de fornecedores, identificar por categoria de gasto, como a transição PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS/ CBS/IBS afeta o custo real de aquisição, o crédito recuperável e a margem efetiva de cada fornecedor;
  • Suporte a renegociação de preços e TCO: auxílio na condução de renegociações baseadas no novo regime de créditos, garantindo que a economia tributária gerada pela não cumulatividade seja apropriada pela empresa (e não retida pelo fornecedor);
  • Revisão e adequação contratual: identificar contratos vigentes que necessitam de atualização de cláusulas tributárias, critérios de reajuste, repasse de custos e condições de pagamento;
  • Qualificação e monitoramento fiscal de fornecedores: implementar critérios ampliados de due diligence fiscal no onboarding e no ciclo de vida do fornecedor, com foco no risco de perda de crédito tributário por inadimplência do parceiro;
  • Análise de sourcing sob a nova ótica de destino: reavaliar decisões de sourcing nacional e regional que dependiam de incentivos fiscais de ICMS, considerando custo logístico total, nível de serviço e nova carga tributária efetiva;
  • Gestão do impacto no working capital: Suporte no mapeamento do efeito da reforma no fluxo de caixa de compras por categoria, em colaboração com Tesouraria e Controladoria;
  • Identificação de oportunidades de crédito: identificar categorias de gasto que passarão a gerar crédito (serviços, locações, transporte) e quantificar o benefício financeiro potencial;
  • Apoio à parametrização de sistemas (ERP/SRM): atuar como bridge entre Compras e as áreas de TI/Fiscal na atualização de cadastros de fornecedores, códigos tributários, parametrizações de CBS/IBS no sistema de compras e processos de source-to-pay;
  • Construção de dashboards e relatórios de risco: desenvolver e manter visões analíticas de exposição tributária por fornecedor, categoria e contrato, para subsídio ao Comitê de Reforma Tributária;
  • Interlocução com o Squad de Reforma Tributária: representar área de Compras no squad multidisciplinar, trazendo a visão de procurement para decisões de malha logística, footprint e estratégia de suprimentos;
  • Entregáveis esperados;
  • Matriz de impacto tributário por categoria de gasto (mapeamento CBS/IBS × PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS atual);
  • Plano de renegociação de preços priorizado por potencial de captura de valor;
  • Relatório de gap contratual (contratos que requerem aditivos tributários);
  • Scorecard de risco fiscal de fornecedores críticos;
  • Dashboard de exposição ao split payment por categoria;
  • Plano de ação de resourcing/realocação de fornecedores (se aplicável);

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em cursos de administração, negócios, compras, comércio exterior, entre outros;
  • Experiência prévia em compras;
  • Strategic Sourcing (análise de mercado, gestão de categorias, BID e RFI/RFQ);
  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos e desenvolvimento de fornecedores;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e sistemas ERP (ex.: SAP, Totvs ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em Reforma Tributária na área de compras

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale transporte/Fretado ou Estacionamento na empresa;
  • Cesta Básica ou Vale alimentação;
  • Restaurante na empresa;
  • Academia e Salão de Beleza na empresa;
  • Desconto nos produtos Cacau Show (Matriz).

title: Analista de Trading Energia Sênior
description:
Na ArcelorMittal acreditamos que uma escolha de carreira vai além da posição, é sobre fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza pessoas, promove o desenvolvimento contínuo e, acima de tudo, coloca a Segurança como um valor inegociável em todas as decisões.

A seguir, você encontrará mais detalhes sobre a ArcelorMittal, a oportunidade, o que oferecemos e o que buscamos nas pessoas que querem construir essa jornada conosco.

Quem somos

Somos a ArcelorMittal, maior produtora de aço do Brasil e uma empresa global que atua com o propósito de produzir aços inteligentes para as pessoas e para o planeta. Somos uma organização que evolui continuamente, impulsionada por pessoas, inovação e pela busca constante por soluções mais eficientes e sustentáveis. A ArcelorMittal é uma das principais empresas integradas de aço e mineração do mundo, com operações em 60 países e produção primária de aço em 15. Com mais de 125.000 empregados no mundo, atendemos clientes em diversos setores, como automotivo, construção, energia e engenharia. Nossos produtos fazem parte do dia a dia, causando um impacto positivo em indivíduos, comunidades e na sociedade.

Na nossa cultura, as pessoas estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos e é por isso que a Segurança, nosso valor fundamental, orienta nossas ações, decisões e a forma como trabalhamos todos os dias.

Fazer parte da ArcelorMittal é integrar um ambiente em constante transformação, onde:

A segurança e o cuidado com as pessoas vêm sempre em primeiro lugar

  • A inovação e a tecnologia são aplicadas para gerar valor com responsabilidade
  • O aprendizado é contínuo, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento
  • A diversidade de perspectivas fortalece nossas decisões e resultados

Buscamos pessoas que queiram evoluir junto com a empresa, contribuindo de forma responsável, colaborativa e comprometida com resultados sustentáveis.

Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na gestão de riscos de energia do Grupo no perímetro Américas, contribuindo para a definição e execução de estratégias de hedge nos mercados de energia, gás e eletricidade dos Estados Unidos, México e Canadá;
  • Realizar operações com derivativos nos mercados financeiros, incluindo produtos estruturados e opções;
  • Elaborar análises e atualizações de mercado para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança e do Senior Management;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar controles de posição, relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de performance da área;
  • Liderar operacionalmente estratégias de posicionamento no mercado de energia brasileiro;
  • Monitorar a curva de mercado, identificar oportunidades e apoiar a definição de estratégias comerciais e financeiras;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com contrapartes do mercado de energia, fortalecendo parcerias e oportunidades de negócio;
  • Contribuir para a gestão do portfólio de energia da ArcelorMittal Brasil, em alinhamento com a AM Treasury e a Gerência de Operações Financeiras;
  • Realizar controles, conciliações, relatórios e acompanhamento das operações junto à CCEE;
  • Acompanhar e analisar impactos regulatórios do setor elétrico, com foco em decisões da ANEEL e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Monitorar indicadores e fundamentos de formação de preços de energia, incluindo dados e sinalizações do ONS;
  • Desenvolver análises avançadas, modelos financeiros e automações que aprimorem a tomada de decisão e a eficiência dos processos.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos da área.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Experiência no setor elétrico brasileiro;
  • Vivência na gestão de riscos, comercialização ou operações no mercado de energia;
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação e interação em ambiente global.

Benefícios:

  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Auxílio academia
  • Cesta de Natal
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte
  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Retorno de Férias
  • Previdência Privada

Como funciona nosso processo seletivo?

Nosso processo seletivo é conduzido de forma estruturada, transparente e respeitosa, considerando tanto aspectos técnicos quanto a aderência à nossa cultura. Ao longo da jornada, buscamos conhecer não apenas suas experiências, mas também como você se conecta com ambientes que valorizam:

  • Segurança
  • Cuidado coletivo
  • Responsabilidade nas decisões

Esta é a etapa inicial do processo. Conforme avance, as demais etapas incluem entrevistas com o time de Pessoas e com a liderança, além de avaliações complementares ao longo do processo e ao final, etapa admissional.

Estamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em se juntar ao nosso #TIMAÇO e esperamos receber a sua candidatura. Para saber mais sobre a gente, acesse nossas redes sociais.

title: Analista Assuntos Regulatórios PL - Pós Registro
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêuticas da América Latina?

A Blau é uma indústria farmacêutica líder no segmento hospitalar e pioneira em biotecnologia, com portfólio proprietário de medicamentos de alta complexidade, com foco em segmentos relevantes da indústria, como imunologia, hematologia, oncologia, especialidades e antibióticos em diversas classes, entre outros.

A Blau possui footprint continental, estando presente em seis países da América Latina e nos Estados Unidos. Conta com um moderno complexo industrial farmacêutico, composto por cinco plantas industriais com tecnologia de ponta, dedicadas à produção de medicamentos biológicos, biotecnológicos, oncológicos, antibióticos, anestésicos injetáveis e insumos biotecnológicos.

Principais Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Elabora dossiês de renovações, alterações pós-registro e cumprimentos de exigência. Medicamento Similar, Genérico, Produto para Saúde e Biológicos. Além de IFAs e BPF/GMP.
  • Monitora e atualiza das planilhas de controle do departamento.
  • Avalia tecnicamente os dossiês no âmbito de requisitos técnicos (fórmula, especificação e metodologia analítica, artes de bula e rotulagem, atributos de qualidade), à luz das regulamentações vigentes. Revisa os materiais de embalagem (Bula, Cartucho e Rótulo)
  • Elabora questionamentos para ANVISA e acompanha o andamento dos processos na ANVISA.
  • Analisa a documentação técnica e elabora o racional do impacto regulatório sobre as alterações pós-registro (CM, HMP), bem como elabora o PATE (Parecer de Avaliação Técnica da Empresa).
  • Efetua a análise de viabilidade técnica de dossiê e elabora parecer.
  • Elabora a abertura de controles de mudança para alteração de material de bula e rotulagem, informando os prazos para esgotamento do material remanescente e implementação das novas artes, entre outros, quando necessário.
  • Acompanha as mudanças na Legislação Sanitária, trabalho conjunto com Associações de classe e antecipação de tendências.

Necessário

  • Experiência em Assuntos Regulatórios de medicamentos.
  • Vivência em produtos sintéticos e injetáveis.
  • Experiência na elaboração de petições de alterações pós-registro, respostas a exigências técnicas e manutenção do ciclo de vida regulatório dos produtos.
  • Legislação sanitária aplicada ao registro e Pós-Registro de medicamentos.
  • RDCs e Instruções Normativas da ANVISA relacionadas a medicamentos sintéticos e injetáveis.
  • Elaboração de dossiês regulatórios.
  • Gestão documental regulatória.
  • Pacote Office (Excel intermediário/avançado).
  • Inglês avançado (desejável)
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em formato 100% presencial

Local: Rod. Raposo Tavares, km 30,5 - Cotia - SP

Horário: Seg - Qui - 07h45 - 17h e Sex até 15h33

A Blau respeita e apoia a diversidade e não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo.

description:
Sobre a vaga

Supervisor(a) de Manutenção Elétrica

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Manutenção Mecânica que será responsável por supervisionar as atividades de manutenção mecânica em equipamentos, estabelecendo prioridades de execução e distribuição das tarefas conforme as necessidades e a disponibilidade de recursos, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, visando garantir a funcionalidade e disponibilidade de equipamentos para atender às metas de produção e qualidade exigidas.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Orientar tecnicamente a realização dos fluxos de trabalho na área sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo procedimentos operacionais, treinando e formando sua equipe; visando garantir planos e metas, qualidade, segurança, meio ambiente e custo de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de novos projetos de melhoria contínua, referente a mecânica e o desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de materiais;
  • Supervisionar e organizar as atividades de manutenção programada e corretiva sob sua responsabilidade, efetuando a distribuição das tarefas específicas conforme as necessidades, programação e a disponibilidade de recursos;
  • Supervisionar o cumprimento do plano de manutenção, programando e acompanhando a execução dos trabalhos e verificando o cumprimento de plano de ações e metas pertinentes;
  • Supervisionar a manutenção nas paradas programadas, verificando o andamento dos trabalhos, consignação de equipamentos, liberação e testes para entrada em produção, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, visando garantir a realização das atividades conforme a programação definida.
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades de manutenção realizadas por terceiros, avaliando o nível do serviço executado, o cumprimento das normas de segurança e cronogramas de realização, bem como realizar as medições e avaliação do serviço executado, visando garantir o nível de qualidade.
  • Acompanhar e realizar registros referentes às manutenções preventivas e corretivas no sistema de gerenciamento de manutenção, na sua área de competência, de acordo com os procedimentos internos.
  • Supervisionar as atividades de consignação, garantindo o bloqueio de fontes de energia mecânica, hidráulica, pneumática, térmica, radiação e de movimentação, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, visando garantir a segurança nas atividades de manutenção dos equipamentos.
  • Participar na elaboração do orçamento e controlar os custos de manutenção da área, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e cronogramas, visando o cumprimento das metas definidas.
  • Garantir as atividades de teste de potencial zero nas fontes de energia mecânica, hidráulica, pneumática, térmica, radiação e de movimentação, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, visando à certificação da não movimentação dos equipamentos bloqueados, para garantir a segurança nas atividades de manutenção dos equipamentos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de acompanhamento das atividades, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e cronogramas definidos, visando dar suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Avaliar e manter-se atualizado em relação às ocorrências do turno, participando de reuniões, visando identificar e orientar as ações, quando necessário, para sanar as irregularidades.
  • Executar as atividades com o mais alto grau de integridade, segurança e em conformidade com todas as normas legais e regulatórias vigentes em nossos locais de nossa atuação, bem como, o atendimento às diretrizes estabelecidas nas políticas da Empresa, principalmente aquelas relacionadas à Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Compliance.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da equipe de trabalho, desenvolvendo ações em conjunto com a área de Recursos Humanos, objetivando uma equipe coesa e de alta performance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Técnica em Mecânica e/ou Eletromecânico;
  • Desejável experiência em supervisão de equipes, moagens úmidas ou seca, bombas de polpa, peneiras. Experiência com Lixiviação ou Dessorção serão um diferencial.

The project is part of a next-generation SaaS technology platform operating in the transportation and supply chain logistics domain. The company behind the platform has decades of industry experience and is recognized as an employer of choice, with a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence.

The platform delivers a suite of data-driven software solutions used daily by millions of customers who rely on accurate, real-time insights to make informed business decisions and improve profitability. At its core, the system supports one of the largest digital marketplaces in its industry , processing hundreds of millions of transactions annually and maintaining a massive database representing hundreds of billions of dollars in global market activity.

The technology stack is built to handle extreme scale , high availability, and data accuracy, enabling customers to operate efficiently in a fast-moving, competitive environment. Engineering teams work on highly distributed systems, advanced data processing pipelines, and analytics-driven services that continuously evolve to meet growing market demands.

Responsibilities

Team Management & People Development

  • Manage and support the engineering team ±20 people in LATAM (incl. but not only Brazil) through regular 1:1 meetings.
  • Build strong relationships with team members and maintain a healthy and productive team environment.
  • Support engineers in their professional development and career growth.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
  • Identify performance issues early and create improvement plans when necessary.
  • Support employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
  • Handle and help resolve conflicts within the team.

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Manage the onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth integration into the company and client teams.
  • Support engineers during their first months on the project and monitor their adaptation and performance.
  • Manage the offboarding process and coordinate communication with internal teams and client stakeholders when required.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team.
  • Clarify position requirements, seniority, technical expectations, and team needs.
  • Participate in candidate evaluation and final hiring decisions.
  • Monitor staffing progress and proactively address hiring challenges.
  • Support workforce planning and identify future staffing needs.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Understand client expectations, priorities, concerns, and business needs.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide visibility into team performance, staffing, risks, and delivery-related topics.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively address potential issues.
  • Handle difficult conversations and conflicts between the client, engineers, and the company.
  • Represent the company's interests while maintaining a strong and trusted relationship with the client.
  • Escalate risks and critical issues appropriately and work with both sides toward mutually acceptable solutions.

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Understand the client's organization, business objectives, and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities to expand cooperation with existing clients.
  • Recognize potential needs for additional engineers, teams, or services and communicate opportunities internally.
  • Participate in discussions related to new roles, team extensions, and new areas of cooperation.
  • Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization.
  • Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management

  • Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks.
  • Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts.
  • Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions.
  • Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience

  • Experience managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills.
  • Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations.
  • Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action.
  • Strong conflict-management and problem-solving skills.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience

  • Previous experience working in an IT outsourcing, consulting, nearshore, or software services company is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project .
  • Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests.
  • Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management

  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
  • Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development

  • Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts.
  • Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities.
  • Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope.
  • Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process.
  • Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders.
  • Experience interviewing or evaluating candidates is preferred.
  • Understanding of the Brazilian engineering talent market is an advantage.

Communication & Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong ownership and proactive mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment

  • Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUS™, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE’s global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic relationships with global customers and drive sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
  • Manage the complete sales journey, from market development and customer engagement to RFQ management, negotiation and closing.
  • Partner with OEMs, EMS providers, engineering and procurement teams to deliver reliable electronic component sourcing solutions.
  • Help customers navigate supply chain challenges, including shortages, EOL risks, lifecycle transitions and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with global teams and represent WIN SOURCE at customer meetings and industry events.

Why Join WIN SOURCE

At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond sales. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Connect with global technology companies and help secure the critical components that keep industries moving.
  • Work on real supply chain challenges across automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics markets.
  • Build strategic relationships with global engineering, procurement and supply chain professionals.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE’s global sourcing network and market expertise to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Grow your career in a global organization where your work contributes to more resilient supply chains and future technologies.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.

Benefits & Career Growth

At WIN SOURCE, we recognize and reward people who create impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure, giving high performers the opportunity to maximize their earning potential.
  • Global sales opportunities with international customers, strategic accounts and exposure to worldwide electronics markets.
  • The opportunity to work at the center of the global electronics supply chain, helping manufacturers secure critical components and solve real business challenges.
  • Professional training, industry knowledge development and a clear career path toward commercial leadership.
  • Opportunities to participate in 50+ international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities.
  • A multicultural and collaborative environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Senior Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Leadership

Join WIN SOURCE

Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?

Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.

title: Representante comercial de vendas
description:
Representante Comercial Mobilidade Elétrica

Empresa: Zevos Gestão Comercial

Segmento: Mobilidade elétrica – patinetes elétricos, bicicletas elétricas e soluções relacionadas

Área de atuação: Região a definir

Modelo de trabalho: Externo, com visitas comerciais e acompanhamento remoto

Resumo do cargo

A Zevos Gestão Comercial busca uma pessoa para atuar como Representante Comercial de produtos de mobilidade elétrica , com foco na prospecção, desenvolvimento e gestão de clientes interessados em patinetes elétricos, bicicletas elétricas e demais soluções de mobilidade urbana.

A pessoa será responsável por ampliar a presença comercial da empresa em sua região, desenvolver novos canais de venda, fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes ativos e identificar oportunidades junto a lojas especializadas, distribuidores, revendedores, empresas de mobilidade, locadoras, redes varejistas e outros parceiros estratégicos.

É necessário possuir carteira ativa de clientes na região de atuação , preferencialmente nos segmentos de bicicletas, motocicletas, veículos elétricos, mobilidade urbana, autopeças, esportes, tecnologia ou varejo especializado.

A pessoa deverá manter uma rotina organizada de visitas, prospecção, elaboração de propostas, negociação e acompanhamento de pedidos. Também será essencial conhecer os diferenciais técnicos e comerciais dos produtos, acompanhar as tendências do mercado de mobilidade elétrica e fornecer informações relevantes para apoiar as decisões comerciais da Zevos.

O desempenho será avaliado principalmente pela capacidade de:

  • Desenvolver novos clientes e canais de distribuição;
  • Gerar oportunidades comerciais qualificadas;
  • Converter negociações em pedidos;
  • Ampliar o volume de vendas na região;
  • Manter uma carteira de clientes ativa e recorrente;
  • Cumprir metas comerciais e de cobertura regional;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva durante todo o processo de venda.
Como o cargo se encaixa na organização

A pessoa Representante Comercial fará parte da estrutura de expansão da Zevos Gestão Comercial , contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento das marcas e dos produtos de mobilidade elétrica administrados pelas empresas do Grupo.

Responsabilidades
  • Prospectar novos clientes na região de atuação, identificando lojas, distribuidores, revendedores, redes varejistas, empresas de locação e demais negócios com potencial para comercializar produtos de mobilidade elétrica.
  • Utilizar e desenvolver sua carteira de clientes para apresentar o portfólio de patinetes elétricos, bicicletas elétricas, acessórios, peças e outros produtos comercializados ou administrados pela Zevos.
  • Realizar visitas presenciais e reuniões comerciais para apresentar os produtos, demonstrar seus diferenciais e compreender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, recomendando modelos, condições comerciais e volumes de compra adequados ao perfil, ao público e à capacidade de venda de cada parceiro.
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas comerciais, tabelas de preços, condições de pagamento, prazos de entrega e demais informações necessárias para a tomada de decisão do cliente.
  • Negociar pedidos dentro das políticas comerciais definidas pela empresa, preservando margens, condições de pagamento e objetivos estratégicos.
  • Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vendas, desde a prospecção inicial até a confirmação do pedido, faturamento, entrega e acompanhamento pós-venda.
  • Manter contato frequente com clientes ativos, incentivando a recompra, identificando novas oportunidades e fortalecendo relacionamentos comerciais de longo prazo.
  • Registrar informações sobre clientes, visitas, propostas, negociações, pedidos e oportunidades nos sistemas, planilhas ou ferramentas de gestão utilizadas pela empresa.
  • Elaborar previsões de vendas e fornecer informações sobre negociações em andamento, permitindo o planejamento de estoque, logística e ações comerciais.
  • Acompanhar o mercado regional, observando preços, lançamentos, campanhas, condições comerciais e estratégias adotadas por concorrentes.
  • Compartilhar com a gestão informações sobre tendências, demandas dos clientes, objeções comerciais, produtos mais procurados e oportunidades de expansão.
  • Participar de feiras, eventos, exposições, encontros comerciais e ações de demonstração de produtos, quando necessário.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da marca na região, seguindo as diretrizes de posicionamento, comunicação e apresentação definidas pela Zevos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes internas para solucionar dúvidas relacionadas a pedidos, entregas, pagamentos, documentação, garantia, assistência técnica e pós-venda.
  • Zelar pela imagem, reputação e interesses comerciais da Zevos, mantendo uma postura ética, profissional, transparente e respeitosa em todas as negociações.
  • Cumprir as metas de vendas, faturamento, prospecção, cobertura regional e desenvolvimento de clientes estabelecidas pela empresa.
Qualificações
  • Carteira ativa de clientes na região de atuação.
  • Experiência comprovada em representação comercial, vendas externas, desenvolvimento de distribuidores ou atendimento B2B.
  • Será considerado um diferencial possuir experiência nos segmentos de bicicletas, motocicletas, patinetes, veículos elétricos, mobilidade urbana, autopeças, tecnologia, esportes ou varejo especializado.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Habilidade para realizar apresentações comerciais e demonstrações de produtos.
  • Capacidade de negociação, argumentação e fechamento de vendas.
  • Perfil consultivo, com habilidade para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e propor soluções adequadas.
  • Organização para administrar carteira de clientes, agenda de visitas, propostas, pedidos e acompanhamentos.
  • Proatividade para desenvolver novas regiões, clientes e oportunidades comerciais.
  • Orientação para metas, resultados e crescimento sustentável da carteira.
  • Facilidade para construir relacionamentos comerciais de confiança e longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas digitais, planilhas, aplicativos de comunicação e sistemas de gestão comercial.
  • Disponibilidade para realizar visitas e viagens dentro da região de atuação.
  • Possuir veículo próprio e habilitação válida será considerado um diferencial, conforme a necessidade da região.
  • Conhecimento sobre mobilidade elétrica, especificações de produtos, baterias, autonomia, potência e principais aplicações será considerado um diferencial.
Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos uma pessoa com espírito comercial, iniciativa, responsabilidade e visão de longo prazo, que tenha facilidade para abrir mercados e desenvolver relacionamentos sólidos. É importante ter interesse pelo segmento de mobilidade elétrica e disposição para acompanhar um mercado em rápido crescimento.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Processos e Projetos
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados. Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.

Na Caltec, acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que cada pessoa tem um talento único para contribuir. Essa vaga também se destina a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) ou reabilitados(as).

Atividades

  • Liderar a transição de novos produtos para a escala industrial, definindo fluxogramas de processo (PFD) e diagramas de instrumentação (P&ID);
  • Desenvolver e disponibilizar o pacote de engenharia básica para os departamentos de Obras e Meio Ambiente, incluindo dados preliminares, conceitos de projeto, escopos, especificações técnicas, locações, desenhos básicos e a definição dos principais equipamentos e sistemas industriais;
  • Elaborar orçamentos com alto grau de precisão, aplicando metodologias como FEL 2/3 ou equivalentes, assegurando a viabilidade econômica dos projetos;
  • Calcular indicadores de viabilidade econômica, como ROI e Payback, além de analisar os impactos dos novos projetos no custo operacional (OPEX) da produção;
  • Desenvolver o cronograma macro de montagem industrial, considerando paradas de planta e interfaces com a operação existente, visando minimizar impactos na produção;
  • Promover a internalização de tecnologias alinhadas à cultura da empresa, identificando oportunidades de fabricação interna e de aquisição externa, otimizando a utilização da oficina própria de caldeiraria e mecânica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior concluído em Engenharia Química;
  • Sólida vivência em indústrias de mineração, siderurgia, química, papel e celulose ou sucroalcooleiro;
  • Experiência técnica em projetos que envolvam termodinâmica, transformação de materiais, transporte e escoamento de sólidos, líquidos e gases a granel;
  • Domínio de metodologias (PMBOK) e softwares de planejamento (MS Project);
  • Inglês avançado.

Desejável

  • Desejável conhecimento em SolidWorks e AutoCAD.

title: Creative Content Strategist
description:
Creative Content Strategist | YouTube & Long-Form Video

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week

About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative Creative Content Strategist to take ownership of the strategy and creative direction behind a growing YouTube channel focused on business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and education.

This is a behind-the-scenes creative role. You will be responsible for continuously researching new ideas, developing original video concepts, creating stories and narratives, writing scripts, building storyboards, researching filming locations, and helping shape what each video should look and feel like before the founders step in front of the camera.

The ideal candidate understands YouTube content, storytelling, business, and digital marketing and knows how to turn business expertise into compelling content that people actually want to watch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creative strategy and content planning for the YouTube channel.
  • Research and develop new, original video ideas on an ongoing basis.
  • Study successful YouTube channels and identify formats, storytelling approaches, hooks, and concepts that can be adapted to the brand.
  • Develop compelling video concepts around business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and real-world business stories.
  • Create storylines and narratives that make educational content engaging and entertaining.
  • Write and structure scripts for long-form YouTube videos.
  • Develop storyboards and detailed creative directions for each video.
  • Determine the hook, structure, pacing, key talking points, and overall narrative of each piece.
  • Interview or collaborate with the founders to extract stories, experiences, insights, and expertise that can become strong content.
  • Research interesting entrepreneurs, businesses, trends, case studies, and potential collaboration opportunities.
  • Identify and reach out to potential entrepreneurs or business owners for collaborations and guest appearances.
  • Research visually interesting filming locations in Miami, including hotels, venues, high-rise spaces, businesses, and other unique environments.
  • Provide creative direction for filming setups, locations, environments, and overall visual presentation.
  • Prepare the founders with everything they need before filming so they can execute the content efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the long-form video editor and clearly communicate the intended creative direction.
  • Help establish a repeatable YouTube content production system and maintain an organized content pipeline.
  • Develop approximately one long-form YouTube video per week , with additional shorter long-form content as needed.

Content Focus:

The content will primarily revolve around:

  • Business and entrepreneurship
  • Digital marketing
  • Business growth and strategy
  • Educational content
  • Entrepreneurial stories and interviews
  • Case studies and business lessons
  • Personal branding and founder-led content
  • Interesting business trends and real-world stories

The goal is to create content that educates, entertains, and builds authority, rather than feeling like traditional advertising.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of YouTube content strategy and storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or developing long-form YouTube content.
  • Excellent creative instincts and the ability to consistently generate fresh, original ideas.
  • Strong scripting and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to think visually and imagine how a video should look before it is filmed.
  • Understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, narrative structure, and audience psychology.
  • Strong research skills and curiosity about business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and financial topics.
  • Basic understanding of digital marketing and business concepts.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with founders.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of the creative process.
  • Ability to research and identify interesting filming locations and environments.
  • Comfortable researching and reaching out to entrepreneurs for potential collaborations.
  • Experience with B2B content marketing, educational content, consulting, podcasting, or founder-led content is a plus.
  • A portfolio of YouTube videos or relevant long-form content is required.

Important Role Clarification

Video editing is NOT the primary responsibility of this position.

A dedicated video editor will handle the editing. Your responsibility is to define what should be created and how it should be created—from the initial idea and research through the story, script, storyboard, filming plan, and creative direction.

You will essentially act as the creative director and strategic brain behind the YouTube channel.

You do not need to live in Miami. However, you should be comfortable researching Miami locations remotely using tools such as Google Maps, venue websites, and other online resources.

Experience

We are open to candidates across different experience levels.

A highly experienced YouTube strategist is welcome, but we are equally interested in junior or mid-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional creative thinking, strong storytelling ability, and a genuine understanding of what makes YouTube content compelling.

Your portfolio and creative instincts matter more than a specific number of years of experience.

Schedule

  • Part-Time
  • Approximately 20 hours/week to start
  • Flexible remote schedule
  • Opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the content operation grows

title: Especialista em Tributos

A LongPing agradece o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Head of Sales and Business Development
description:
Sales & Business Development Leader – LATAM

Location: Brazil | Work Model: Remote

Region: Latin America (LATAM)

About the Company

Our client is a global innovator in high-performance polymer and flash-spun material technologies , providing advanced material solutions across industrial protection, healthcare, technical textiles, semiconductor, packaging, and sustainable applications.

Driven by innovation and scalable manufacturing capabilities, the company delivers application-oriented B2B solutions to customers worldwide through established industrial and distribution networks.

As part of its global expansion, the company is now building its presence across Latin America and is looking for an entrepreneurial commercial leader to establish and grow the regional business.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Sales & Business Development Leader based in Brazil to lead the development of the company's protective garments and apparel business across LATAM.

The role will focus on both branded material solutions used in protective garment manufacturing and a portfolio of finished protective clothing . The successful candidate will combine strong industry knowledge with commercial and technical capabilities, helping customers identify the right solutions based on performance, regulatory, application, and supply chain requirements.

As the first commercial hire in LATAM , this is a highly entrepreneurial role. The successful candidate will be expected to build the market from the ground up — identifying opportunities, developing customer relationships, establishing distribution channels, supporting product trials, and converting opportunities into sustainable revenue.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Market Building

  • Develop and execute the LATAM business development strategy for protective apparel, disposable garments, PPE, and technical clothing.
  • Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, PPE brands, and end users .
  • Build the company's customer and partner network across key LATAM markets.
  • Identify target accounts, applications, market segments, and new routes to market.

  • Develop the business from an early-stage market position, taking ownership from lead generation through to commercial execution.

2. Portfolio Sales

  • Promote and sell branded high-performance materials used in the production of protective garments.
  • Develop sales of the company's finished protective garment portfolio.
  • Understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate solution based on performance, application, regulatory, cost, and supply chain considerations .
  • Develop commercial proposals, negotiate with customers, and manage the sales cycle through to closure.
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular forecasts and market updates.

3. Technical & Application Support

  • Advise customers on material selection and protective garment performance requirements.
  • Support technical discussions relating to fabric performance, barrier properties, material selection, garment construction, and manufacturing processes .
  • Work closely with customers and internal technical teams on product trials, testing, qualification, and garment evaluations.
  • Translate customer requirements into practical material and product solutions.
  • Support customers through product evaluation, qualification, and onboarding.

4. Market Development & Intelligence

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer needs, and regulatory developments across LATAM.
  • Identify emerging applications and growth opportunities within protective clothing, disposable garments, PPE, and technical textiles.
  • Develop market intelligence and provide actionable insights to global product, R&D, and commercial teams.
  • Identify opportunities for new products, applications, partnerships, and market entry strategies.
  • Represent the company at relevant industry events, exhibitions, and customer forums.

5. Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Build long-term relationships with garment manufacturers, distributors, PPE brands, procurement teams, and key end users.
  • Conduct customer visits, product presentations, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations.
  • Develop strong relationships across technical, procurement, commercial, and senior management levels.
  • Support customers throughout product evaluation, qualification, implementation, and ongoing business development.
  • Develop and manage strategic distributors and channel partners where appropriate.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with global sales, marketing, product development, R&D, technical, operations, and supply chain teams.
  • Bring LATAM customer and market requirements into global product and commercial discussions.
  • Coordinate customer projects and ensure effective follow-up from opportunity identification through commercialization.

Requirements

Experience & Technical Knowledge

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant sales or business development experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Protective garments / protective apparel
  • Disposable apparel
  • PPE products
  • Technical textiles
  • Nonwoven materials
  • High-performance materials used in protective clothing
  • Proven experience working with garment manufacturers, converters, distributors, PPE brands, or industrial end users .
  • Good understanding of materials used in protective clothing, including nonwovens, laminates, technical fabrics, polymers, or barrier materials .
  • Understanding of protective clothing standards, certification, and performance requirements is highly desirable.
  • Experience selling finished protective garments or PPE products is a strong advantage.
  • Technical knowledge of textiles, materials science, polymer engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Commercial Capabilities

  • Strong track record in B2B sales and business development , preferably within technical or engineered products.
  • Ability to develop new markets and generate business from a relatively low existing customer base.
  • Strong consultative selling and solution-selling capabilities.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable engaging with both technical stakeholders and senior commercial/procurement decision-makers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand customer economics and supply chain requirements.

Languages

  • Fluent English is required.
  • Portuguese is required for the Brazil-based role.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially driven, and comfortable operating in a build-up environment .

As the company's first commercial hire in LATAM, this person will not simply manage an existing customer base. They will be expected to build the business from scratch — identify prospects, open doors, develop relationships, create opportunities, support technical evaluations, establish channels, and ultimately generate sustainable revenue.

The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of protective garments and technical textiles with strong commercial execution , enabling the company's branded materials and protective clothing solutions to become preferred solutions for customers across multiple industries.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership and operates with a high level of autonomy.
  • Is comfortable being hands-on across the entire sales cycle .
  • Has a strong hunter mentality and enjoys opening new markets.
  • Can build relationships from scratch and turn technical discussions into commercial opportunities.
  • Is technically credible with customers while remaining commercially focused.
  • Is willing to travel extensively across LATAM as the business develops.
  • Can work effectively with a global organization and multicultural teams.
  • Is excited by the opportunity to build something new and create the foundation for the company's LATAM business .

What Makes This Opportunity Attractive?

  • First commercial hire in LATAM with significant ownership and visibility.
  • Opportunity to build a regional business from the ground up .
  • Exposure to innovative high-performance polymer and advanced material technologies.
  • Direct interaction with global commercial, technical, and R&D teams.
  • Broad responsibility covering business development, sales, technical application, and market development.
  • Opportunity to shape the company's LATAM go-to-market strategy and long-term regional growth .
  • Remote-based position in Brazil with significant regional responsibility.

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfield is engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach to the brand called Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from

adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Production Technician Trainee
description:
Position: Production Technician Trainee

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Job Purpose

Execute routine inspections and predictive/preventive maintenance activities on topside systems and equipment, ensuring safe and reliable operations in accordance with company procedures, permit-to-work requirements, and supervisor instructions.

Responsibilities

Perform routine rounds throughout the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance and report abnormal conditions.

Execute first-line maintenance on process systems and equipment in accordance with CMMS work orders, daily inspections, and supervisor instructions.

Conduct line walks to verify proper system isolations before Permit to Work (PTW) release.

Prepare systems and equipment for maintenance activities, including draining, cleaning, and purging prior to handover.

Perform preservation activities, visual inspections, vibration, temperature and noise checks, oil changes and top-ups, cleaning of filters, strainers, drains, and sight glasses, gasket replacement (when specific competency is not required), and paint touch-ups.

Ensure all activities are carried out in compliance with company procedures, SOPs, and safety requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Chemical, or related Engineering fields, from a recognized educational institution.
  • Recent graduate with up to 2 years of graduation.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial operations, maintenance, process systems, or equipment inspection gained through academic studies, internships, or practical training.
  • Willingness to learn and develop technical skills in offshore operations, first-line maintenance, equipment inspections, and Permit to Work (PTW) procedures.
  • English: Intermediate (mandatory for Brazilian candidates).

Benefits

Life Insurance.

Annual Bonus.

Private Pension Plan.

Childcare Allowance.

Note: This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Company Description deepidv is redefining human and AI verification with a proprietary, end-to-end engine and agentic compliance suite built for modern risk, fraud prevention, and continuous monitoring. The platform replaces legacy, API-stitched identity solutions with a single stack that combines Human + AI decisioning, cryptographic proof, and always-on risk and compliance controls. Every verification is triple-encrypted, auditable, and explainable, ensuring that people, documents, and moments of capture are provably real. deepidv operates across 211+ countries without third-party middlemen and is also the team behind UAIIP (Universal AI Identity Protocol) at getai.id, which establishes verifiable identities for AI companions. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and founded by a team with multiple successful exits in fintech and retail.

Role Description The Social Media Content Creator at deepidv is a full-time, remote role responsible for developing and executing content that grows brand awareness and engagement across social platforms. In this role, you will plan and produce short-form and long-form content (posts, threads, videos, carousels), translating complex topics like AI, cryptography, and risk/compliance into accessible, compelling narratives. You will manage daily posting schedules, community interactions, and real-time engagement, including replies, DMs, and comment moderation. You will collaborate with marketing, product, and leadership to align content with key launches, thought leadership, and go-to-market priorities, while monitoring analytics to refine messaging, formats, and channels. You will also stay current on social trends in AI, security, and fintech to propose new content concepts and experiments that elevate deepidv’s voice in the market.

Qualifications

  • Strong social media content creation and storytelling skills, including experience crafting platform-native content for channels such as X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and TikTok.
  • Ability to translate technical or complex topics (AI, identity, security, cryptography, compliance) into clear, engaging, and accurate narratives for varied audiences.
  • Experience with social media strategy, content planning, and editorial calendars, including campaign-based and always-on content.
  • Proficiency with basic design and multimedia tools (e.g., Canva, Figma, or similar), and comfort collaborating with design or video partners.
  • Skill in community management, including handling comments, DMs, and online discussions in a professional, inclusive, and brand-aligned manner.
  • Familiarity with social analytics tools and metrics (engagement, reach, CTR, follower growth) to inform iteration and reporting.
  • Excellent written communication skills in English, with meticulous attention to tone, clarity, and accuracy.

title: SBS Operations Senior Manager
description:
At Sherwin-Williams, we color the world! With more than 150 years of global excellence, we are a leader in the paints and coatings industry, recognized for innovation, quality, and our commitment to sustainability.

We are seeking an experienced SBS Operations Senior Manager to lead and advance our Shared Business Services operations across Brazil. This role partners closely with SBS Service Delivery teams and business leaders to drive service excellence, operational effectiveness, and strategic growth.

The SBS Operations Senior Manager plays a critical role in overseeing regional service delivery, managing demand pipelines, capacity planning, service placement strategies, and supporting key SBS initiatives across Brazil. This leader will also be responsible for monitoring and improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring the organization consistently delivers high-quality, efficient, and scalable services. Beyond operational leadership, this role is empowered to drive transformation through influence, collaboration, communication, and execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will champion process standardization, harmonization, optimization, and automation, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, strong governance, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who thrives in complex environments, builds strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, and is passionate about developing high-performing teams while driving meaningful business impact across Brazil and LATAM.

São Bernardo do Campo, SP, Brazil | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

  1. Build and manage regional processes, business requirements, documentation, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories. Manage and continuously enhance SBS processes within the service catalog, including the evaluation of current services, regional systems, taxonomies, tools, business process master lists, and repository governance.
  2. Lead the execution of the regional transition program , focusing on process standardization, harmonization, streamlining, optimization, and control analysis. Partner closely with SBS Service Delivery teams to identify, design, and implement process improvement initiatives and supporting tools.
  3. Prepare and manage the facility budget , process facility-related charges, and monitor expenditures throughout the year to ensure proper financial oversight and cost control.
  4. Partner with SBS leadership to build the foundation for the organization and support its continued growth and maturity, driving sustainable operational capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
  5. Execute regional transition initiatives to ensure smooth service transfers, effective stakeholder alignment, and seamless handoffs between teams.
  6. Develop and implement programs that strengthen operational excellence capabilities , including the assessment, design, and deployment of training initiatives. Promote consistent ways of working, cross-functional collaboration, waste reduction, process standardization, and risk mitigation.
  7. Serve as a senior influencer across global, regional, and local leadership teams. Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized SBS processes and operating models. Build strong partnerships across Finance, SBS, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, while effectively communicating vision, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  8. Build and develop high-performing teams across LATAM. Drive initiatives that enhance operational excellence capabilities, professional development, and organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced professional certification.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, Shared Services, Operations, or a related business function, with a proven track record in operational excellence, process management, transformation, and business partnership.
  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Spanish proficiency is preferred.
  • Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, build cross-functional relationships, and drive alignment across global, regional, and local teams.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams both directly and through influence in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC), multinational organization, or business transformation environment is highly desirable.
  • Previous people leadership experience and exposure to transition management, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives are preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end business processes, including areas such as Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Hire-to-Retire (HTR), and other Shared Services processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and performance management frameworks.
  • Experience developing execution strategies, operating procedures, governance models, and process documentation.
  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, process standardization, and operational excellence principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Shared Services technologies, workflow tools, automation solutions, and ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience supporting automation, digital transformation, or process optimization initiatives.

About Us

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life ... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to improve your health and well-being.

title: Logistics Specialist- First Mile
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

Key Responsibilities

● Pickup Operations Management: Oversee daily pickup operations across Brazil, ensuring sellers are collected within SLA and operational targets. Coordinate pickup flows with logistics providers, monitor execution quality, and proactively address operational risks, delays, and capacity constraints.

● Supplier Coordination & Performance Management: Manage relationships with pickup service providers and carriers, conducting regular operational reviews, aligning volume forecasts, and ensuring compliance with company standards and KPIs. Drive accountability and corrective actions when performance deviations occur.

● Data Analysis & Decision Making: Analyze operational data, pickup performance, seller behavior, capacity utilization, and cost indicators to support strategic and operational decision-making. Develop reports and dashboards to identify trends, operational bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.

● Operational Planning & Execution: Support short-, medium-, and long-term pickup planning, balancing operational efficiency, service quality, and cost optimization. Coordinate operational contingencies during peak periods and large-scale campaigns.

● Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Identify operational gaps and implement initiatives to improve pickup efficiency, reduce failures, enhance seller experience, and optimize operational costs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve systems, operational processes, and execution standards.

● Incident Management & Escalation Handling: Lead operational issue resolution related to pickup execution, seller complaints, collection failures, and supplier performance. Ensure fast escalation, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive actions.

● Field Operations & Seller Experience: Conduct field visits with logistics providers and sellers to validate operational standards, improve pickup experience, and ensure operational compliance. Maintain close visibility of frontline operational challenges.

● Strategic Projects & Network Development: Support strategic initiatives related to pickup network expansion, operational model optimization, collection point management, and logistics performance improvement projects.

Requirements

● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related fields.

● Minimum of 5 years of experience in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce, express logistics, or first mile operations.

● Strong knowledge of pickup operations, logistics supplier management, operational KPIs, and field execution.

● Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical skills with the ability to make operational decisions based on data, performance indicators, and operational trends.

● Operational & Analytical Profile: Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution in a fast-paced environment.

● Problem-Solving Skills: Strong ability to identify root causes, manage operational risks, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

● Supplier Management Experience: Experience coordinating logistics providers, conducting performance reviews, and driving operational improvements.

● Project Management Skills: Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional logistics projects.

● Hands-on Approach: Willingness to engage directly with field operations, logistics providers, and sellers to ensure operational excellence.

● Portuguese fluency is mandatory.

● Intermediate English is required; fluent English is considered a strong plus.

● Spanish and/or Mandarin are considered a plus.

CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Plant Operations Manager
description:
About Teknia – We are a multinational industrial company specialising in manufacturing metal and plastic components for mobility. Founded in 1992, we operate 21 production plants across 11 countries and employ more than 3,500 professionals. By combining a wide range of technologies, we collaborate with the leading manufacturers in the global automotive sector.

We are the sum of our factories and the people who make them possible. A growing company that has evolved thanks to the commitment and talent of our people.

About the Position – We are looking to hire an Industrialization Manager to join our team in our TEPEJI DEL RIO PLANT (MEXICO) .

The selected candidate will lead operations and capital investment projects while ensuring plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements. They will drive operational excellence across the plant, guaranteeing the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets in line with customer expectations and business objectives. The role will also be responsible for promoting continuous improvement initiatives, operational efficiency, and compliance with automotive industry standards.

The responsibilities of the position include:

  • Lead small, medium, and large-scale industrialization and capital investment projects using project management methodologies.
  • Ensure plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements.
  • Coordinate production line modifications and engineering change management activities.
  • Manage contractors, suppliers, and internal resources involved in projects.
  • Control project budgets, capital expenditures, and investment execution.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, suppliers, and customers to achieve project and operational objectives.
  • Lead plant operations, ensuring compliance with production schedules and operational targets.
  • Drive the implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, and TPM initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with automotive quality standards, including IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, and SPC.
  • Lead audits and oversee corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Promote a strong safety culture, cost control, and talent development across the organization.
  • Monitor and improve operational KPIs to enhance plant performance and competitiveness.

Experience and Education

  • Academic Background: Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. A Master's Degree is considered an advantage.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar leadership role and 8-10 years of experience within the automotive industry.
  • Proven experience managing plant operations, preferably within Die Casting and Machining environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Continuous Improvement methodologies, KPI management, and Project Management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing large-scale industrialization projects.
  • Language Skills: Fluent English.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to operational challenges.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

If you're looking for a dynamic environment and a project with international scope, Teknia is the ideal place for you . We look forward to receiving your application!
